sources.title: KideCo-Miner · GitHub
sources.snippet: KideCo-Miner is an AI-IoT Decision Copilot for coal-mine hauling operations. It transforms raw sensing data from hauling trucks — GPS, payload scales, cabin cameras, trip logs, and weather sensors — into a unified Hauling Decision Score and a set of explainable AI recommendations that help mine supervisors act faster and more confidently.
